selected.title: ClearToken wins Bank of England approval to clear tokenised assets
selected.summary: ClearToken, a a London-based clearing house for global digital assets, has been approved by the Bank of England to operate a Digital Securities Depository (DSD) in the Digital Securities Sandbox.
selected.why: Bank of England approval marks key milestone in UK digital securities and clearing infrastructure.

reason: UK bank regulator approval for tokenised asset clearing creates testable claims about whether regulatory sandbox success predicts market adoption
angle: Regulatory approval of tokenised finance infrastructure proves the technology solves real problems for wholesale finance, not that it will actually be used at scale
